name: Run The Set
description: Run The Set is an event hosted by Incendium Gaming, that runs at the TMU Rogers Communication Centre in Toronto. The games they run include Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, Guilty Gear Strive, Under Night In-Birth II, and Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising. Please not that this event does not run every month.

name: Steel City Showdown
description: Steel City Showdown is an event hosted at Mohawk College in partnership with Incendium Gaming. The games they run include Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, Guilty Gear Strive, Under Night In-Birth II, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, and more.

name: Stun City
location: 627 Bloor St W 3rd Floor, Toronto, ON
description: Stun City is an event hosted by Toronto Top Tiers, hosted at Anime Otaku Hobby in downtown Toronto. The games they run are Street Fighter 6, Fatal Fury: COTW and Tekken 8.

name: DKM Offside
description: DKM Offside is an event hosted by DKM Network in St. Catharines. They host Guilty Gear Strive and Rivals of Aether 2. For more information, please join the DMK Network Discord.

name: Just Mids
description: Just Mids is an event hosted at The Upper Hand in Mississauga. They run Guilty Gear Strive and Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising on an alternating weekly schedule, on Thursday nights.

name: Plus Mids
description: Plus Mids is an event hosted at The Upper Hand in Mississauga. It is a monthly-style event that runs quarterly, and features big brackets for Guilty Gear Strive and Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising.

name: Whiff City
description: Whiff City is an event run by SMRT eSports in Barrie. It is a monthly event that is hosted in the CW Coop's restaurant. The mainstay games they host include Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, and Guilty Gear Strive, with some variety games at different events.

name: DTR x TKO
description: DTR x TKO is an event run by Downtown Rumble in Ottawa. It is a weekly event with a different main game every week, hosted in the Level One Game Pub. Downtown Rumble hosts their brackets on Challonge, and announces them in the Ottawa FGC Discord, linked on the discord button on their Organizaiton profile.

name: Capital City Clash
description: Capital City Clash is an event run by Downtown Rumble and Battle City at the Algonquin College AC Hub in Ottawa. It is a monthly event, where they run Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising, Under Night In-Birth II, Guilty Gear Strive, Guilty Gear Xrd, and more. Please check either the Ottawa FGC Discord or the Battle City Discord for the Start.gg link and more information.

name: Battle City
description: Battle City is a weekly run by Battle City in Ottawa. They run mainly Street Figher 6 and Tekken 8 with some other variety games depending on the week. Please check either the Battle City Discord for the Start.gg link and more information.

name: The Local
description: The Local™ is the premiere melee weekly located in the heart of downtown Toronto. The venue is a great bar space with lots of good eats in the area and TTC accessible.

name: Poacher's Arms Weekly
description: The Poacher's Arms Weekly is a community event organized by the London Ontario FGC at the Poacher's Arms bar. While they meet weekly, they don't always have a bracket every week. They play a variety of different games. Tournaments are hosted on Challonge with on-site signups, so please check the London Ontario FGC Discord for more information.

name: Mana Pinball Friday Meetup
location: 1742 Hyde Park Rd unit 3, London, ON
description: The Mana Pinball Friday Meetup is an event run by the London Ontario FGC at Mana Pinball in London. Join their Discord for more information!

name: SMASH CLASS
description: SMASH CLASS is a weekly run by Smash Class at St. Clair College in Windsor. They meet weekly at the Nexus Open Gaming Lab in the main building of the St. Clair campus, and host games such as Tekken 8, Guilty Gear Strive, King of Fighter XV, Street Fighter 6, and more.

name: Boyceblue
description: Boyceblue is a monthly event hosted by the Windsor FGC. They meet monthly on Saturdays, and run tournaments each month, with a different game every month. They host practically anything fighting game related, so even if not many people play a particular game you might be interested in, you still usually can find people to play with. EVERYONE OF ALL GAMES/SKILL LEVELS ARE WELCOME! Please join the Discord for more venue information!

name: UWFGC Weekly Meet
description: The UWFGC Weekly Meet is a weekly event hosted at the University of Waterloo by the UWFGC. The event is open to the public. Every week to two weeks, they host a bracket, the game depending on what attendees want. Some games they host include Street Fighter 6, Tekken 8, Guilty Gear Strive, Under Night In-Birth II, Guilty Gear Xrd, and more.

name: Secena FGC Club Meet
location: 70 The Pond Rd, North York, ON
description: The Seneca FGC club meetups are events hosted by the Seneca FGC in North York, on the Seneca@York Campus. These meetups can have casual game nights, tournaments, and other community-related activities. Please note that you do not have to be a student to attend. Please join the Seneca FGC Discord for more information on scheduling and room location.

name: Crit Hit Fight Night
description: Crit Hit Fight Night is a weekly hosted in Durham at the Critical Hit Gaming Lounge. They host a Street Fighter 6 bracket with setups for various casual games available after the bracket. They have a healthy mix of players from beginners all the way to masters, and welcome anyone looking for anything from casual to high skilled competition! Please join their discord for more information.

name: YUFGC Weekly Meetup
description: The YUFGC weekly meetup is an event held weekly at York University by YUFGC. It is open to anyone, and you don't have to be a student to attend. YUFGC mostly holds casual meetups for many games (Street Fighter, Tekken, Guilty Gear, Uni2, KOF, Blazblue, etc.) and hosts monthly tournaments for players of all skill levels. Join the YUFGC Discord for more info on scheduling and room location.

name: Richmond Hill Locals
location: 636 Edward Ave Unit #4, Richmond Hill, ON
description: The Richmond Hill Local is an event held at the Derpy Cards card store in Richmond Hill. Their Bi-Weekly casual meetups are free attend and play, and when they host tournaments there is an entry fee. Common games that attendees play include Street Fighter 6, GGXrd, MBAACC, COTW, and many retro games! For more information and announcements on available games, the upcoming schedule, and more, join their Discord.

name: Forest City Fighers
location: 1742 Hyde Park Rd unit 3, London, ON
description: Forest City Fighers is a new monthly tournament run by the London Ontario FGC at Mana Pinball. The current games they run are Fatal Fury: COTW, Guilty Gear Xrd, Tekken 8, Street Fighter 6, and BBCF, but these are subject to change. It is important to join their Discord if you intend to attend, so please check it out for more info!

name: Kingston Kerfuffle
location: Ellis Hall room 324, 58 University Ave, Kingston, ON
description: Weekly tournaments run by the Queen's Fighting Game Club! (Non-students more then welcome to come to events) Features Smash Ultimate, Smash Melee, Street Figher 6, Guilty Gear Strive, Tekken 8, Street Fighter 3 and more! Please check out the Queen's FGC Discord found above for bracket info!

name: Beans Beatdown
description: Beans Beatdown is an event run by Peterborough FGC, hosted by Dreams of Beans café. It runs Street Fighter 6 and Tekken 8 on alternating months with a secondary game as voted by the discord community.

name: Combo Trials
description: Scarborough FGC local happening biweekly on fridays mainly focused on 2XKO as the main title + 2 other games as more casual, free to enter brackets every event.

name: The Den
description: Monthly double-elim Street Fighter 6 hosted at Denthreesixty Arcade.
